title: Give assistant_output the same ASCII fallback as _tool_message
problem_type: legacy Windows 控制台（cp1252）下 rich 的 legacy 渲染器对模型输出中的不可编码字符（如 U+25BA）抛 UnicodeEncodeError，assistant_output 无守卫，一个字符毁掉整个会话
approach: 镜像同文件 _tool_message 已有的 ASCII 兜底模式：errors=replace 编码后以纯 Text 重打；两条路径（Text/Markdown）均有回归测试

policy.summary: CONTRIBUTING 无 AI 禁令、无 DCO；#5945 同仓先例（CLA 已由账号持有者签署，仓库贡献通道畅通）

collision.summary: issue #5951 timeline 0 cross-ref、0 评论、无认领语言；邻近编号 #5949-#5953 无同题 PR；session_claims 原子认领（本轮工作前未做 issue 级动作，PR 开出前完成认领）

verification.case: issue #5951 场景：console.print 抛 UnicodeEncodeError('cp1252', ...)（与 issue 回溯逐字一致）时 assistant_output 的 Text 路径与 Markdown/pretty 路径均不外逃；tests/basic/test_io.py 全量
verification.summary: 修复前 2 个新回归测试 fail（异常外逃）；修复后 26/26 passed；black 23.3.0/flake8 7.1.0/isort 5.12.0 全净；follow-up db36771 把兜底扩展到 tool_output（issue #5953，repo-map U+22EE）

before.environment: Windows 10 (Git Bash), Python 3.12.4 venv, aider deps

after.environment: Windows 10 (Git Bash), Python 3.12.4 venv, aider deps
after.test_case: issue #5951 场景：console.print 抛 UnicodeEncodeError('cp1252', ...)（与 issue 回溯逐字一致）时 assistant_output 的 Text 路径与 Markdown/pretty 路径均不外逃；tests/basic/test_io.py 全量

submission.head: db36771be8d7df48df5c4cf915d78a23b63198a6

claims.text: **Both fail on unpatched code (verified via stash A/B), 25/25 pass with the fix.**
Pinned lint clean on both touched files: `black 23.3.0 --line-length 100 --preview`, `flake8 7.1.0`, `isort 5.12.0` (the repo's pre-commit pins).
the same fallback now guards that site too, with its own regression test.

limitations: The legacy-Windows render path itself (`legacy_windows_render` → `LegacyWindowsTerm`) only activates on a real legacy console, which CI's Linux runners (and this PR's test suite) do not exercise; the tests target the guard that survives it, and the mocked exceptions match the issues' tracebacks byte-for-byte.
Remaining `console.print` call sites have the same theoretical exposure; the PR keeps to the two reported paths (`assistant_output`, `tool_output`) to stay atomic.
